messages:
alex: heads-up — i'm handing primary to sam in ~10m. quick pass-through before i leave: PD pages, AWS assume-role, Grafana dashboard access, and runbook pointers. shout if you see any gaps. :wave:

sam: ok i'm good to take. can we do a live access check now? specifically i think i only have Grafana Viewer role for prod dashboards (can't open some panels). PD shows me as scheduled primary though.

maya: i can update Grafana perms if needed. to be explicit: does sam need Editor or just Dashboard View + API key? Editor is safer for quick mitigation (dashboard edits, annotations).

jin: PD schedule is fine — sam is on the rotation. i don't have PD admin rights to change escalation policies. if we need sam in the "oncall-sre-assign" group, that'll need infra help.

infra-bot: checklist hint: verify AWS assume-role with SSO and MFA, confirm PagerDuty receives test alert, and load critical Grafana panels (latency, error-rate, inference-queue). runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/handoff-checklist

alex: stepwise for handoff — copy this and run quickly:
1) PagerDuty: open https://pagerduty.com/organizations/redwood/schedules and confirm your name on the current schedule.
2) PagerDuty test: from terminal use internal pd-cli (or PD UI) to send a test alert to the PROD escalation policy: 

```
pd trigger --service svc_prod_inference --summary "handoff-test" --details "handoff test from alex -> sam"
```

3) AWS: login via SSO then assume prod ops role and run: 
```
aws sso login --profile redwood-prod
aws sts get-caller-identity --profile redwood-prod
```
expect to see the prod account id.

4) Grafana: open https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/prod-overview and make sure panels load. if you get 403, check folder permissions or request temporary Editor.

5) Secrets & keys: if you need a Grafana API key for automation/alerts, request temporary via #eng-infra-access with template in runbook.

sam: running checks now — PD schedule good. triggering pd test...

oncall-bot: Incident simulation: test alert sent to "sam" via PROD escalation policy — please acknowledge to confirm paging. :bell:

sam: acknowledged — received page (mobile + email). looks good.

sam: aws sts check returned the expected prod account id. MFA worked. grafana still 403 for the folder "prod-dashboards" (can't view panel json). maya can you open the folder and confirm my role?

maya: i just gave sam Editor on the folder `prod-dashboards` for the duration of shift (temp until 1934600000). i added a note in Grafana folder activity. sam — try again.

sam: refreshed, panels load now. can view graph annotations and add a note. good. thanks maya.

sam: one access gap: i can't assign incidents to the SRE team from PD — UI greys out the "Assign" dropdown for group "oncall-sre". jin, can you confirm group membership?

jin: i added sam to PD group `oncall-sre-assign` and updated the policy to allow assignment from primary. it should propagate within a minute. try assigning.

sam: assign now works. good.

alex: a couple of extra reminders before i go:
- if you get a P0, follow the incident runbook severity checklist (link above). create the incident channel, invite stakeholders, and start the timeline doc.
- fallback: if primary doesn't respond within 5m of critical page, secondary should escalate. our APAC coverage gap is 02:00-05:00 UTC tonight — jin will be watching that window.

maya: added the APAC overlap note to the handoff doc and pinned it in #eng-oncall.

infra-bot: quick commands reference for triage being shared here: 
```
# check pd oncall
pd whoami
pd incidents list --service svc_prod_inference --status triggered

# assume role and run sample logs query (CLI helper)
aws sso login --profile redwood-prod && aws logs tail /aws/inference/prod --follow --profile redwood-prod
```

sam: testing a simulated incident response: created a small test incident, followed the runbook, started a channel, added owners. everything looks ok.

alex: confirmed. i'm logging this handoff in the rotation sheet and the oncall log. final note: if you need emergency Grafana admin (e.g., to create a new API key), the only path is #eng-infra-access with the template (include reason, expiry, and who will rotate the key). maya — please rotate any temp keys at end of shift.

maya: will rotate and add a comment to the runbook entry.

sam: i'm taking primary now. thanks alex — have a good one. leaving access notes in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/handoff-checklist#1934567890-handoff-sam

alex: leaving. sam primary; jin secondary; maya on grafana/keys. APAC coverage: jin monitor 02:00-05:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: primary=sam, secondary=jin, handoff_ts=1934567890. Additions to runbook logged.

sam: got it. all set.
